description: Reconstructed NG-pairs from Appendices C and D of Balonin & Djokovic (arXiv:1508.00640v1).

reconstruction.a: The paper records a[0..t]; reconstruct a as a_truncated + reverse(a_truncated[1:t]).
reconstruction.b: The paper records b[0..t-1]; reconstruct b as b_truncated + (-reverse(b_truncated)).
